profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Brooks Automation
profile.summary:
Software engineer with over 28 years experience working in defense, satellite and semiconductor industries.

Specialties: Languages: C#, C++, C, Ada

Operating Systems: Windows, UNIX (Solarus, AIX), Linux

Frameworks: .NET through 4.5, ASP.NET 

Software Development Tools: Microsoft Visual Studio, SQL Developer, PVCS, SVN, Continuus, CVS, TFS

Technologies: WinForms, WPF, XAML, XML, XSD, LINQ, GDI+, MFC, STL, TCP/IP, Web Services, SECS/GEM, OOP, OOD, real-time development, multithreading, shared memory, web services, middleware

Applications: Microsoft Office

Databases: Oracle

Some product management, customer support, onsite support, quality assurance experience.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architect, code, test, and design features for Brooks SMS-II Wafer Sorter application product.  Currently Product Lead and sole developer for the application.  Expanded the product over the years to be configurable and support numerous aligners, flipper, nitrogen purge, and various different wafer thickness types.  Helped convert software from legacy process communication protocol to WCF.  Manage the SEC/GEM interfaces to customer Station Controller software within the application.  Support SEMI E5, E30, E39, E40, E94, E87, E90, E116 changes as necessary and custom non SEMI Standard features in the product. Work directly with customers to define requirements and test cases for the product.  Resolve escalations as they arise in daily scrums. Use C# and Visual Studio, WCF, WPF, XML, Winforms for development.  Ported product from Windows XP to Windows 7 to Windows 10 currently.  Provide customer and onsite support as needed.  Work with marketing to scope features and product project schedules. 

Developed and tested applications software for a Jedec Tray Sorter. Development included adding new recipes and modifying SEMI Host Communication interfaces to support Jedec Tray and Load Port hardware on the Sorter. Working on Tray Sorter features again as of 2024.

Developed and tested second generation applications software using C# for 300mm and 200mm Wafer Sorters.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and tested second generation applications software using C#/WinForms for new state-of-the-art 450mm Wafer Sorter.  

Designed and coded a .NET GEM interface using C# and XML schemas (XSD); developed GUIs in both WinForms and WPF/XAML; performed all QA testing and CM for a new automated semiconductor wafer buffering product.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with a team to translate a large legacy Forte government application into C# on .NET 3.0 using an Oracle database. 

Enhanced and coded client side windows using C#, WinForms. Wrapped .NET Toolbox Controls to behave like Forte.
 
Improved layout, performance, highlighting, scrolling, tabbing, key processing on DataGridView controls.

Debugged and resolved many stability, layout, and performance issues

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed web applications, controls, and services, and user controls for a project which visualized tool status and vehicle movement in a semiconductor fab in real-time.

Designed, developed, and tested semiconductor connectivity software.  Managed and led development of products also.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: See Asyst.  Asyst acquired GW Associates in April 2001.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Performed all design, development, maintenance, and documentation for a real-time satellite telemetry visualization product. 

Developed client/servers for satellite control systems using a series of COTS and custom products.

company.name: Storm Control Systems (acquired by L3 Communications 1998)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as part of large development team to replace the Air Force Satellite Control Network (AFSCN) mainframe implementation with a workstation based solution.

Performed software maintenance releases on the AFSCN system.  Advanced to a project lead position.

positions.title: Computer Programmer
positions.description: Wrote programs to support testing of scout and attack helicopters for U.S. Army.  Developed programs to edit raw data into various reports and formats to be used for analysis by military personnel.
